publication_decision: Candidate for the next Noether multilingual/linguistics rollup. Preserve the full logbook/reflection apparatus. Treat as a rendered and audited work-so-far language lane, not as a critical edition, not as independent German source closure, and not as a complete 43-paper Slavic corpus.
package_scope_from_manifest: Papers01--34 through complete Paper34 Section26, source-corrected through the late Section18/Section19/Section20/Section21/Section22/Section23/Section24/Section25/Section26 boundary.
status_summary: The package is intentionally both mathematics and linguistics evidence: it includes rendered Slavic TeX/PDF outputs, cumulative glossaries, script policy notes, terminology decisions, Interslavic logbooks, and constructed-language workflow reflections.
The standing rules inside the package say translation is from the German source spine, with English/control translations as aids only.
The package treats Ukrainian, Russian, and Interslavic/Panslavic as parallel canonical lanes rather than copies of one another.
The Interslavic lane is explicitly a language-engineering workflow with Latin authority text and deterministic Cyrillic reader variants, not a claim of final language authority.
The package policy excludes old stages, credentials, stale path dumps, and bulky raw scan floods unless needed as current audit evidence.
caveats: Work-so-far through Paper 34 Section 26 only; the 43-paper corpus is not complete in these Slavic lanes.
Source-corrected means aligned to the current working source spine and cited source-fidelity checkpoints, not independent critical-edition certification.
The package is large and should be included deliberately in the next Noether rollup or a clearly labelled Slavic/language-lane file, not uploaded as a vague raw dump.
Any public description should foreground the logbooks/reflection files as part of the scholarly object, especially for Interslavic.
next_action: Fold this package into the next Noether multilingual refresh with a clear label such as 'Slavic work-so-far through Paper 34 section 26 (Ukrainian/Russian/Interslavic, with logbooks)'. Do not call it complete; do include the logbooks and constructed-language reflections.
